manual.title: Enter official hall readings
manual.description: Enter current readings from your account or leave them blank. Use decimal GB. Only enter general data from the monthly plan.

manual_update.title: Record a new reading
manual_update.description: A new balance replaces the old balance. If you enter any traffic field, the traffic group is replaced and blank traffic fields become unavailable.

sms.title: Set up SMS forwarding
sms.description: Enter at least one complete template based on a verified message. Find the secret webhook path under Reconfigure after setup.

sms_update.title: Configure SMS forwarding
sms_update.description: Append this secret path to your local Home Assistant URL: `{path}`. Keep it private. A change to the sender, templates or unit base clears the current readings.

portal.title: Connect the official website session
portal.description: Import credentials from your signed-in account tab. Leave the package name blank for balance only. See the integration documentation for instructions.

error.invalid_sender: Enter an exact sender of up to 64 characters.
error.invalid_template: Use a complete template and the documented placeholders.
error.invalid_portal_session: Check the exported session and request headers.
error.portal_auth_failed: The carrier rejected the session. Refresh the website credentials.
error.cannot_connect: The carrier query failed. Try again later.
error.invalid_portal_curl: Use Copy as cURL (bash) on the qryBalanceFee request in the Network panel.
error.portal_challenge: The carrier returned a browser verification page. Copy a fresh successful balance request from the signed-in tab.
